title: I Let the Reserved-Stairmill Scanner Catch the Trainer Who Stood on Mine

parts.text: I tapped stairmill 4 at 6:03 a.m. and trainer Blaise was already climbing on my app hold. The console said: SCAN TO START. THIRTY MINUTES. NO FLOOR SAVES. I was thirty, member, holding a phone that listed 4. I photographed the console, the hold, and Blaise's shoes. Then I let the scanner refuse a second start. Front desk pinged why Blaise's name was on my hold. Blaise stepped off. The steps finally look like an app, not a favor. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.
